definitions.gloss: receipt; written acknowledgment that something has been received
definitions.explanation: A document confirming that goods, money, or documents have been received. Used in both commercial transactions and official procedures.

examples.japanese: {受取証|うけとりしょう}をください。
{荷物|にもつ}を{受|う}け{取|と}ったら{受取証|うけとりしょう}にサインしてください。
examples.english: Please sign the receipt when you receive the package.

examples.japanese: {確定申告|かくていしんこく}のために{医療費|いりょうひ}の{受取証|うけとりしょう}を{保管|ほかん}しておいたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should keep your medical expense receipts for your tax return.

notes:
Formed from {受取|うけとり} (receipt, receiving) + {証|しょう} (proof, certificate). A formal term for a receipt that proves something was received. In everyday shopping, レシート (register receipt) or {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ} (formal receipt) are far more common. {受取証|うけとりしょう} is used specifically when acknowledging receipt of deliveries, documents, or payments in official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受取証|うけとりしょう}にサインする: to sign a receipt
- {受取証|うけとりしょう}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue a receipt
- {受取証|うけとりしょう}を{保管|ほかん}する: to keep/store a receipt
- {受取証|うけとりしょう}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a receipt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}: receipt — the most common formal receipt for payments, especially for business expense claims
- レシート: receipt — the slip printed at a cash register; casual everyday term
- {受領書|じゅりょうしょ}: receipt of goods/documents — synonym, slightly more formal and official
